subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should workspace hook metadata above 1 MiB be silently omitted across runtime and CLI discovery, or surfaced with a clear oversized-hook diagnostic?
rationale: The memory bound is justified, but current code and docs do not define the new ceiling or silent disappearance as supported hook behavior.

options.title: Expose a diagnostic
options.body: Use the shared reader and report why the oversized hook is unavailable in operator-visible surfaces.

options.title: Accept silent omission
options.body: Define 1 MiB and silent skipping as the supported workspace hook contract.

options.title: Pause the ceiling
options.body: Hold the PR until workspace and installation paths share an approved metadata policy.

recommendation.title: Expose a diagnostic
recommendation.body: Use the shared reader and report why the oversized hook is unavailable in operator-visible surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership and merge-history signal for the affected hook and filesystem boundary paths points here.
